_comment: Everything the three targets agree on. scripts/build.mjs merges this with
the per-target overlay in manifests/<target>.json and writes the result to
dist/<target>/manifest.json. Edit this file, not the generated ones.
The mark is declared at four sizes rather than one. Browsers downscale a
single 128 for the 16px toolbar slot themselves, and the neon spikes on
this artwork do not survive that — each size is rendered from the source
manifest.json at the repo root is the Chrome build, and the only manifest
that belongs there: it is where a browser looks when the repo is loaded
unpacked with no build step. It is generated — see the README.
name: butter_jira
description: Visualize your Jira in a Gantt chart, using a backlog list or Kanban views across all your Jira boards, run an efficient daily standup, and see your team's GitHub activity. Fast, lean, no AI. ButterJira: Fighting bloat since 2026.
